patch.summary: Bolt for Business implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Bolt for Business by mapping current hr workflows to Bolt for Business objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (priority systems) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on systems of record

blocks.heading: Bolt for Business day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Bolt for Business setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for HRIS integrations before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Teams needing employee ride-hailing with central billing before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate priority integrations before reopen.

blocks.title: Bolt for Business implementation go / no-go

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite
Do not expand seats until HRIS integrations is green

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Bolt for Business plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Bolt Business
lines.description: Contact sales · Unlocks: HRIS integrations, analytics and reporting · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate hr fit before a deep Bolt for Business rollout
blocks.body: If Bolt for Business fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Bolt for Business object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on HRIS integrations
If blocked, evaluate Navan before sunk-cost expansion
